title: A Joomla band the page keeps (keepScopes) keeps its own buttons and links under a worn system: the module sheet's primary-button and accent-text rules stop at its edge, where var(--ds-c-accent) is reset to no colour
steps: S1: From packages/design/tracy-ds-slot run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/cms.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, '# fail' and the result of the test named in expect.
expect: 'Joomla: a kept band keeps its own buttons and links — the primary-button rule stops at its edge' is ok: in the Moxie module sheet for templates/joomla-ja-mood.json the primary-button rule (background-color var(--ds-c-accent)) carries exactly the contract's buttonPrimary selectors, each ending in :not(.ja-topbar, .ja-topbar *, .t3-masthead-mask, .t3-masthead-mask *, .t3-footer, .t3-footer *); the joomla-tracy-base sheet (no kept band) carries no such exclusion.

selectors.rule: src/joomla.mjs: sel.buttonPrimary and sel.accentText through outsideKept(contract)
selectors.keep: src/tokens56.mjs keepRules (--ds-c-*: initial inside a kept band)

fence: the Joomla module sheet's colour rules at kept bands; not the band's own inherited text colour (measured separately, see the evidence)

tests: Joomla: a kept band keeps its own buttons and links — the primary-button rule stops at its edge
